title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25U (Penalty for committing unfair labour practices)

content.overview: Section 25U prescribes the penalty for committing an unfair labour practice.
content.glance: Section 25U prescribes the penalty for committing an unfair labour practice.
content.study: Any person who commits an unfair labour practice shall be punishable with imprisonment, fine, or both, as provided in section 25U.
